title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
lineage: 10 inch 1/2 track Master Reels @ 7.5 ips > Revox A700 > Alesis Masterlink ML 9600 > CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a marathon 1970 double‑show with crisp guitar, stellar Pigpen organ and iconic performances of The Other One, Dark Star and Attics.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑mixed soundboard that retains the historic quirks of the early acoustic set (right‑channel dropouts and a bit loud vocal mix) but overall sounds clear and balanced. Musically the show is legendary – two full Dead sets bookended by New Riders, rare Attics, a monster The Other One, soaring Dark Star and a host of beloved classics that keep listeners hooked for hours.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic language point to an outstanding performance; the recording is praised as excellent soundboard with only minor early‑set issues, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix and minimal hiss noted by several reviewers; early acoustic portion suffers from right‑channel dropouts, occasional fade‑in/out and overly loud vocals, but overall the sound is clean and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A historic double‑show (early + late) with two acoustic sets, New Riders interludes and two full electric sets; reviewers describe it as a marathon but well‑paced, with seamless transitions and an unforgettable second half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar tone is repeatedly praised – described as crisp, powerful and the driving force behind The Other One and Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s vocals get kudos (Mama Tried, Sawmill) and his rhythm work noted as solid throughout the marathon set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ and vocal presence are highlighted as clear and surprisingly sober; keyboards overall are described as well‑balanced in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill/Kreutzmann’s drumming is mentioned positively (e.g., “crisp” and “great”) with no major complaints.
